ns2:course.label: Sens Prosth Devices Hear Loss
ns2:course.description: Seminar on current research in signal processing approaches and experimental protocols for the development and fitting of hearing aids, tactile aids, cochlear implants, and assistive listening devices. Prerequisite: SHS 553 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: SHS 553 or consent of instructor.
